package.purpose: First-planet playable journey with persistent surface fog, artifact restoration, collection, base and day/night; continues the existing v037 campaign and preserves prior source backups

policy: Computed from actual source/ZIP, raw local check files and fixed-package captures. No acceptance/status registry is written. Raw tests receive source qualification only after their checkout, runtime trees and hashes are verified.
knownLimits: Desktop touch emulation is not a physical phone test.
Paint P95 is reported as measured; no stable 60fps claim.
Sound-cue events and silent films are not audible audio verification.
Platform readback does not imply an unavailable remote ZIP checksum.
Local full-check logs are not a remote CI completion record.
MP4 hashes bind captured H.264 review files; this compiler does not measure physical device codec/GPU presentation.

engineering.scope: Complete local raw check, source-qualified here; not a CI success declaration or visual/phone acceptance

performance.scope: Not measured. Decoded image, GPU and total-process residency are not inferred from the JavaScript heap.
